# `aitbc bootstrap bootstrap-env`

Generate a starter .env file and validate it, optionally overwriting an existing one.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bootstrap bootstrap-env [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output` | text | `.env` | no | Output .env file path |
| `--overwrite` | flag | `false` | no | Overwrite existing .env |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bootstrap bootstrap-env
aitbc bootstrap bootstrap-env --output json
```
